_note: Simulated personas for automated testing. They are NOT research participants and their results are not human findings. Dimensions are independent: career stage does not determine expertise or digital literacy. No demographic attributes are used to infer competence.

personas.label: Doctoral trainee

dimensions.accessibilityNeeds: none declared (separate accessibility scenarios cover this)
dimensions.accountEntitlement: as per manifest account actually used
dimensions.institutionalResources: large US public university, busy advisor

personas.startingKnowledge: A labmate said EQUITAS helps develop research ideas. Has not seen the site.
personas.goal: Turn a vague idea into a feasible research question.
personas.reasonableExpectations: A clear starting point, plain explanations, clarifying questions, a short prioritized next-step list.
personas.appropriateDepth: Guided, explained, but scientifically rigorous; no premature methods.
personas.stoppingRules: Give up if you cannot find a plausible next step after 6 actions without progress, or after 4 failed attempts to find a control, or if the only way forward requires paying, changing settings, or entering personal details.
